name: Hayama Minato
source:
Minato is Hiroki’s genius classmate who is very energetic and is always chatting away to Hiroki during school. She also enjoys playing online multiplayer games so usually manages to make Hiroki stay and play them with her.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/01/otome-kairo-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
